<infobox theme="Event">
        <data source="prev"><label>Previous</label></data>	
        <data source="conc"><label>Concurrent</label></data>	
        <data source="next"><label>Next</label></data>	
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header></header>
        <data source="conflict"><label>Conflict</label></data>
        <data source="date"><label>Date</label></data>	
        <data source="place"><label>Place</label></data>	
        <data source="outcome"><label>Outcome</label></data>
        <data source="keyparties"><label>Affiliations involved</label></data>
        <data source="participants"><label>Participants</label></data>		
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Event|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

===Usage===
To use this template, paste the following code into the top of the article, filling all relevant fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Event
|prev=
|conc=
|next=
|image=
|name=
|conflict=
|date=
|place=
|outcome=
|keyparties=
|participants=
}}
</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
